commit 6372f0c 2026-11-24T12:04:38.000Z Likhith Vardhan Goruputi
DEMO-9: retry transient payment failures in shared client

Retry timeouts and 5xx responses, tighten the per-attempt timeout so a
slow attempt is abandoned quickly, and drop the fixed backoff.
files: M libs/httpclient/VERSION
M libs/httpclient/policy.py
M services/checkout/VERSION

diff --git a/libs/httpclient/VERSION b/libs/httpclient/VERSION
index fd2a018..944880f 100644
--- a/libs/httpclient/VERSION
+++ b/libs/httpclient/VERSION
@@ -1 +1 @@
-3.1.0
+3.2.0
diff --git a/libs/httpclient/policy.py b/libs/httpclient/policy.py
index 15dd75d..a404ba1 100644
--- a/libs/httpclient/policy.py
+++ b/libs/httpclient/policy.py
@@ -1,10 +1,10 @@
 """Default call policy for internal service-to-service HTTP calls.
 
 Services use these values unless their own config overrides a field.
 """
 
-DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000
-MAX_RETRIES = 1
+DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 250
+MAX_RETRIES = 4
 # Which failures are retried: "connect_error", "timeout", "5xx"
-RETRY_ON = ("connect_error",)
-BACKOFF_MS = 100
+RETRY_ON = ("connect_error", "timeout", "5xx")
+BACKOFF_MS = 0
